    About Stellar

    Stellar is an open payments network for issuing assets and moving money across borders quickly and cheaply. XLM pays network fees and serves as a bridge asset.

    Where this XLM price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (XLM-USD), Binance (XLM/USDT) and Kraken (XLM/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade.
